tactical_explanations:
A small firm choosing niche buyers still needs a full mix.

Read the claim as a manager setting the mix dials.

The assertion tracks the marketing-mix reading for this point: Increasing the number of lines widens the product mix. That is how a fitness-tracker start-up selling online would treat the relevant P, life-cycle stage, or portfolio cell when aiming at a researched target market.

Flip the claim against the book’s definitions and it breaks.
